description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for git pathspec globbing behavior, including various options and flags related to globbing and literal pathspecs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing the given commands.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified parameters, used in setting up test conditions.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files for test validation.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the output is empty, used for negative test cases.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock or timestamp used in git commits.
